editorial:
Imagine you are on a long train ride with nothing but your thoughts until you meet a mysterious older woman who seems friendly but keeps secrets. You play as Iris Carr, a wealthy young woman traveling alone who quickly bonds with this stranger. The whole setup feels like a classic mystery, but things take a creepy turn when Iris falls asleep for a short bit. When she wakes up, the woman is completely gone. The scary part is that everyone else on the train swears the woman was never there in the first place. It makes you wonder if Iris is losing her mind or if there is a huge conspiracy happening right under her nose.

The acting is solid and the mystery keeps you guessing until the very end. While the pace starts a bit slow, it picks up speed once the panic sets in. If you like stories where you feel like you cannot trust anyone, you will love this.
endingExplained: You find out that the woman was not a ghost or a dream, but a target of a secret plot. The other passengers were actually working together to kidnap her and gaslight Iris into thinking she was crazy. In the end, Iris manages to figure out the truth and helps the woman escape. They outsmart the villains just in time, proving that Iris was right all along and the group was lying.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves puzzles and twisty stories.
